name: toggle-group
title: ToggleGroup
purpose: Connect exclusive or multiple persistent pressed-state actions with direct pointer affordance.

composition.selection: Single mode emits one id and optionally allows empty selection; multiple mode emits an immutable id array.
composition.keyboard: Roving tabindex follows the selected or first enabled item and supports axis-aware arrows, Home, End, and wrapping.

accessibility: Keep every option label explicit even when an icon is present.
Skip disabled items during roving focus.
commonMistakes: Passing an array model in single mode.
Using ToggleGroup for unrelated one-shot actions.

examples.title: Single selection
examples.description: Use single mode for one active alignment or view choice.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import ToggleGroup from "@/components/ui/ToggleGroup.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AlignCenter, AlignLeft, AlignRight } from "@lucide/vue";

const alignment = ref("left");
const options = [
  { id: "left", label: "Left", icon: AlignLeft },
  { id: "center", label: "Center", icon: AlignCenter },
  { id: "right", label: "Right", icon: AlignRight },
];
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleGroup v-model="alignment" :options="options" label="Text alignment placeholder" type="single" />
</template>

examples.title: Multiple selection
examples.description: Multiple mode keeps independent formatting actions pressed together.

examples.title: Persistent single selection
examples.description: Disable empty selection when the surrounding task always requires one active mode.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import ToggleGroup from "@/components/ui/ToggleGroup.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AlignCenter, AlignLeft, AlignRight } from "@lucide/vue";

const alignment = ref("center");
const options = [
  { id: "left", label: "Left", icon: AlignLeft },
  { id: "center", label: "Center", icon: AlignCenter },
  { id: "right", label: "Right", icon: AlignRight },
];
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleGroup v-model="alignment" :options="options" label="Text alignment placeholder" type="single" :allow-empty="false" />
</template>
